risk_note: RV2 (db/invariants, only additions). Ledger invariants support reversal vouchers (BR-FUND-16 / BR-FUND-19 ③④; orchestrator 2026-10-19 17:0x ruling, decisions 32-34). The merged 03_credit-unique.sql counts CREDIT vouchers per beneficiary key, so an original plus its ':REVERSE' voucher (same voucher_kind) would be reported as a duplicate. db/invariants is append-only, so this adds db/invariants/ledger/09_credit-unique-net.sql (output invariant still '03', checked_rows same as old 03) and superseded.json ([{file, replaced_by, reason}]) for the daily-check runner B2-02j to skip 03_credit-unique.sql. 09 looks at CREDIT only; an original is excluded only when it pairs with its ':REVERSE' voucher by structured columns AND their entries net to zero per (account, sub_account, ledger_type, sub_type) with no extra reversal lines; more than one effective CREDIT per key, orphan reversals and non-offsetting pairs are reported. 04 already counts reversal amounts in the net and is not replaced (rule tests prove it). Files 01-07 unchanged. Integer fen sums only; read-only SELECT.
